in_sanskrit.name: मुकेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of death or god of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who controls death (Yama) or the one who bestows wealth (Kuber).

in_hindi.name: मुकेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who deals with death (Yama), the one who bestows blessings (Prasad).

in_tamil.name: முகேசன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds power (Kallar), the one who creates wealth (Kalai pār).

in_telugu.name: ముఖేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who holds wealth (Deśi yal), the one who bestows wealth (Deśipōdu).

in_marathi.name: મુકેશ
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who delights
in_marathi.long_meaning: મુકેશ हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who delights or pleases the gods; a name of Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: મુકેશ
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One who delights
in_bengali.long_meaning: મુકેશ একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who delights or pleases the gods; a name of Lord Shiva.
